info.title: IPS core receiver
info.description: The endpoints a core banking system implements and the IPS middleware (the gateway) calls: incoming payments, recalls, initiations and refusals, the status callback for transactions the core system sent, and the payment-status query for a delivery the gateway got no final answer to. Host them with the IPS.MiidleWear.AspNetCore package (AddIpsCoreReceiver and MapIpsCoreReceiver over an IClientPaymentReceiver from IPS.MiidleWear.Contracts). Each operation's description states the rules the gateway applies to the answer.

servers.description: The core system's receiver, configured in the gateway as the CBS base URL.

post.summary: Receive an inbound pacs.008 (same shape as the send request, plus debtor.participantBic) and return the final posting result.
post.description: Idempotency-Key = endToEndId; a repeated key must get the first answer. Final answer: HTTP 2xx with Status ACCP, or RJCT with a ReasonCode. Leave Id and TxId empty (the delivery carries neither); EndToEndId may be omitted, and when present it must equal endToEndId. RJCT is final, so answer a technical failure with an error status, never with RJCT. The answer becomes the pacs.002 to IPS. Anything else is not an answer (another Status such as PDNG, a non-2xx status, unreadable JSON, a duplicate member, or no answer in time). The gateway then asks the payment-status query until the IPS deadline. Still without a final answer, IPS is told RJCT and the gateway keeps asking: a 404 does not resend the payment and ends in manual review, and a credit confirmed later is reversed through the status callback (direction Incoming, status Rejected).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The payment's endToEndId. The same key is a redelivery of the same message and must get the first answer.

post.summary: Receive an inbound pacs.009 FI-to-FI credit transfer.
post.description: Idempotency-Key = endToEndId; a repeated key must get the first answer. Final answer: HTTP 2xx with Status ACCP, or RJCT with a ReasonCode. Id, EndToEndId and TxId may be omitted; when present they must equal the delivered id, endToEndId and txId. RJCT is final, so answer a technical failure with an error status, never with RJCT. Anything else is not an answer (another Status such as PDNG, a non-2xx status, unreadable JSON, a duplicate member, or no answer in time). The gateway then asks the payment-status query, posts the message again after its 404, and keeps asking until its window (24 hours by default) ends in manual review. IPS has already been acknowledged; the answer goes only to the gateway.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The transfer's endToEndId. The same key is a redelivery of the same message and must get the first answer.

post.summary: Receive an inbound pacs.004 payment return.
post.description: Idempotency-Key = id (the return id); a repeated key must get the first answer. Final answer: HTTP 2xx with Status ACCP, or RJCT with a ReasonCode. Id may be omitted; when present it must equal the return id. RJCT is final, so answer a technical failure with an error status, never with RJCT. Anything else is not an answer (another Status such as PDNG, a non-2xx status, unreadable JSON, a duplicate member, or no answer in time). The gateway then asks the payment-status query, posts the message again after its 404, and keeps asking until its window (24 hours by default) ends in manual review. IPS has already been acknowledged; the answer goes only to the gateway.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The return's id. The same key is a redelivery of the same message and must get the first answer.

post.summary: Receive an incoming pain.001 payment initiation from a PISP (answer to IPS: pacs.008 PSP- or pain.002).
post.description: Idempotency-Key = paymentInformationId; a repeated key must get the first answer. Final answer: HTTP 2xx with Status ACCP, or RJCT with a ReasonCode. Id may be omitted; when present it must equal paymentInformationId. RJCT is final, so answer a technical failure with an error status, never with RJCT. Anything else is not an answer (another Status such as PDNG, a non-2xx status, unreadable JSON, a duplicate member, or no answer in time). The gateway then asks the payment-status query, posts the message again after its 404, and keeps asking until its window (24 hours by default) ends in manual review. IPS has already been acknowledged; the answer goes only to the gateway.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The initiation's paymentInformationId. The same key is a redelivery of the same message and must get the first answer.

post.summary: Receive an incoming camt.056 recall request (answer to the recall: pacs.004 or camt.029).
post.description: Idempotency-Key = id; a repeated key must get the first answer. Final answer: HTTP 2xx with Status ACCP, or RJCT with a ReasonCode. Id may be omitted; when present it must equal id. RJCT is final, so answer a technical failure with an error status, never with RJCT. Anything else is not an answer (another Status such as PDNG, a non-2xx status, unreadable JSON, a duplicate member, or no answer in time). The gateway then asks the payment-status query, posts the message again after its 404, and keeps asking until its window (24 hours by default) ends in manual review. IPS has already been acknowledged; the answer goes only to the gateway.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The recall's id (Assgnmt/Id). The same key is a redelivery of the same message and must get the first answer.

post.summary: Receive an incoming camt.055 cancellation request for a payment initiation.
post.description: Idempotency-Key = msgId; a repeated key must get the first answer. Final answer: HTTP 2xx with Status ACCP, or RJCT with a ReasonCode. Id may be omitted; when present it must equal msgId. RJCT is final, so answer a technical failure with an error status, never with RJCT. Anything else is not an answer (another Status such as PDNG, a non-2xx status, unreadable JSON, a duplicate member, or no answer in time). The gateway then asks the payment-status query, posts the message again after its 404, and keeps asking until its window (24 hours by default) ends in manual review. IPS has already been acknowledged; the answer goes only to the gateway.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The cancellation request's msgId (Assgnmt/Id). The same key is a redelivery of the same message and must get the first answer.

post.summary: Receive an incoming camt.029 refusal of a recall the core system sent.
post.description: Idempotency-Key = id; a repeated key must get the first answer. Final answer: HTTP 2xx with Status ACCP, or RJCT with a ReasonCode. Id may be omitted; when present it must equal id. RJCT is final, so answer a technical failure with an error status, never with RJCT. Anything else is not an answer (another Status such as PDNG, a non-2xx status, unreadable JSON, a duplicate member, or no answer in time). The gateway then asks the payment-status query, posts the message again after its 404, and keeps asking until its window (24 hours by default) ends in manual review. IPS has already been acknowledged; the answer goes only to the gateway.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The refusal's id (Assgnmt/Id). The same key is a redelivery of the same message and must get the first answer.

post.summary: Receive the status of a transaction the core system sent.
post.description: Any 2xx counts as delivered; anything else is retried with the same Idempotency-Key ({clientReference}:{status}, or in:{coreReference}:{status} for an incoming payment), so the same status can arrive more than once and must be handled idempotently. Direction Incoming with status Rejected asks the core system to reverse an incoming pacs.008 it credited after IPS was told RJCT.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: {clientReference}:{status} for a transaction the core system sent; in:{coreReference}:{status} for the reversal of an incoming payment. The same key is a redelivery of the same message and must get the first answer.

get.summary: Return the outcome of an incoming payment (404 when it was never received).
get.description: Query messageKind and reference (the Idempotency-Key of the receive call). Answer 200 with the receive answer (ACCP or RJCT), 200 with Status PDNG while still processing, and 404 only when the message never arrived: the gateway then posts it again, for every kind except pacs.008, whose 404 stays unknown and ends in manual review. An empty 2xx such as 204 is not a 404.

Camt029OriginalTransactionReferenceDto.description:
TxInfAndSts/OrgnlTxRef (#15-16, #21-40). Same shape as the camt.056 one plus IntrBkSttlmAmt (#15), which only
the camt.029 profile carries inside OrgnlTxRef.

ClientReference.description:
REQUIRED. The core system's unique id for this transaction — unique across every message type. The idempotency
key: a repeated request with the same value returns the existing transaction instead of sending again.
On a delivered (incoming) camt.029: the clientReference of the core system's camt.056 recall that it refuses; the
idempotency key is then string? Camt029ResolutionOfInvestigationDto.Id.

Id.description: Assgnmt/Id (#1, Max35Text): this message's id. Also the AppHdr BizMsgIdr.

CreDtTm.description: Assgnmt/CreDtTm (#4). Omit to stamp "now" at XML-build time.

OriginalMessageId.description: TxInfAndSts/OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgId (#7): Assgnmt/Id of the camt.056 being answered (on a delivered camt.029: the core's recall Id).

OriginalEndToEndId.description: TxInfAndSts/OrgnlEndToEndId (#9): EndToEndId of the recalled pacs.008.

OriginalTransactionId.description: TxInfAndSts/OrgnlTxId (#10): TxId of the recalled pacs.008.

ReasonCode.description: TxInfAndSts/CxlStsRsnInf/Rsn/Cd (#13): reason for refusing the recall (Annex D §3.5.6 Recall Nack Reasons, e.g. NOAS, NOOR, ARDT, CUST, AC04, AM04, LEGL).

Camt029ResolutionOfInvestigationDto.description:
JSON REST contract for camt.029.001.13 (Resolution of Investigation) — the creditor participant's negative answer
            to a camt.056 recall (the positive answer is a pacs.004). Carries the client-supplied rows of the NBG field profile
            "IPS_camt.029 - V1" (40 rows; the numbers in the remarks are that table's row numbers).
            Rows fixed by Annex D (§3.2.5, §8.1.6) are not on the contract — the gateway always fills them: #2 Assgnr
(participant BIC), #3 Assgne (IPS BIC), #5 Sts/Conf "RJCR", #8 OrgnlMsgNmId "camt.056.001.11", #11 TxCxlSts
"RJCR", #12 CxlStsRsnInf/Orgtr AnyBIC (= CdtrAgt, the participant), #17 SttlmMtd "CLRG", #18 ClrSys "IPS",
#19 SvcLvl, #20 LclInstrm, #22 CdtrRefInf/Tp/CdOrPrtry/Cd "SCOR".The same shape is delivered to the core system at string Camt029RestApiRoutes.Receive when another participant
refuses a camt.056 recall this core system sent: every field is filled from the received message, the debtor agent is
this participant, and string? Camt029ResolutionOfInvestigationDto.ClientReference is that of the refused recall.

Camt055AccountDto.description: CdtrAcct — IBAN only, per Annex D.

Name.description: FinInstnId/Nm: the agent's name, when given.

OriginatorName.description: CxlRsnInf/Orgtr/Nm: who asked for the cancellation, when given.

OriginatorBIC.description: CxlRsnInf/Orgtr/Id/OrgId/AnyBIC: the BIC of who asked for the cancellation, when given.

ReasonCode.description: CxlRsnInf/Rsn/Cd (or Prtry): the cancellation reason code.

AdditionalInformation.description: CxlRsnInf/AddtlInf: free text explaining the reason.

Camt055CancellationReasonDto.description: CxlRsnInf — unlike camt.056, AdditionalInformation is mandatory (Max105Text) per Annex D.

MsgId.description: Assgnmt/Id: the request's message id; also the Idempotency-Key and the payment-status reference.

AssignerBIC.description: Assgnmt/Assgnr/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI: the participant that sent the request.

AssigneeBIC.description: Assgnmt/Assgne/Agt/FinInstnId/BICFI: the participant the request is addressed to.

CreDtTm.description: Assgnmt/CreDtTm: when the request was created, in UTC.

PaymentCancellationId.description: OrgnlPmtInfAndCxl/PmtCxlId: the sender's id of this cancellation, when given.

OriginalPaymentInformationId.description: OrgnlPmtInfAndCxl/OrgnlPmtInfId: the PmtInfId of the pain.001 to cancel (the paymentInformationId this bank received).

CancellationId.description: TxInf/CxlId: the sender's id of the cancelled transaction, when given.

OriginalInstructionId.description: TxInf/OrgnlInstrId: the instruction id of the original transaction, when given.

OriginalEndToEndId.description: TxInf/OrgnlEndToEndId: the end-to-end id of the original transaction, when given.

Camt055CancellationRequestDto.description:
JSON REST contract for camt.055.001.012 (Customer Payment Cancellation Request), modeled after
            Annex D §7.1.13. Used either as a Request for Cancellation (RfC) of a previously sent pain.001 or
            pain.013 message, or as a Request for Status Update (RFSU) on an already-submitted cancellation.
            A single TxInf occurrence is enforced by IPS, so this DTO is flattened the same way the other
            contract-only models in this solution are.
            Delivered to the core system at string Camt055RestApiRoutes.Receive for an incoming camt.055.001.12 about a
pain.001 this bank received; the debtor agent is this participant. Every field is filled from the received message;
date-times are given in UTC, DateTime? Camt055OriginalTransactionReferenceDto.RequestedExecutionDate as a date at
midnight, and JsonElement? Camt055PartyDto.PostalAddress in the shape of the camt.056 postal address
(StreetName, BuildingNumber, PostCode, TownName, CountrySubDivision, Country, AddressLines). Idempotency-Key = string? Camt055CancellationRequestDto.MsgId.

OriginalMessageId.description: OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgId: the message id of the original message.

OriginalCreationDateTime.description: OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlCreDtTm: when the original message was created, in UTC, when given.

Camt055OriginalGroupInformationDto.description: OrgnlGrpInf — identifies which original message is targeted by this cancellation.

Currency.description: OrgnlTxRef/Amt/InstdAmt/@Ccy: the currency of the original instructed amount.

RequestedExecutionDate.description: OrgnlTxRef/ReqdExctnDt: the requested execution date, as the date at midnight.

Camt055OriginalTransactionReferenceDto.description:
OrgnlTxRef — narrower than camt.056/pain.001: Annex D lists only DebtorAgent (institution level,
no full Debtor party/account) alongside a full Creditor party + account.

Id.description: The creditor's identification (organisation or private), when given.

Camt055PartyDto.description: Cdtr — Name + optional Id + raw postal address.

Name.description: FinInstnId/Nm: the agent's name, when given.

Camt056AgentDto.description: DbtrAgt / CdtrAgt: FinInstnId/BICFI and optional Nm (Max140Text).

Issuer.description: CdtrRefInf/Tp/Issr: the issuer of the creditor reference, when given.

Camt056PartyDto.description: Dbtr / Cdtr: Pty/Nm, Pty/PstlAdr, Pty/Id and the party's IBAN account (DbtrAcct / CdtrAcct).

Camt056PostalAddressDto.description: Pty/PstlAdr — the PostalAddress27 elements a Georgian address needs, in XSD order.

ClientReference.description:
REQUIRED. The core system's unique id for this transaction — unique across every message type. The idempotency
key: a repeated request with the same value returns the existing transaction instead of sending again.
Empty on a delivered (incoming) camt.056, whose idempotency key is string? Camt056RecallRequestDto.Id.

Id.description: Assgnmt/Id (#1, Max35Text): this recall message's id. Also the AppHdr BizMsgIdr.

CreDtTm.description: Assgnmt/CreDtTm (#4). Omit to stamp "now" at XML-build time.

OriginalMessageId.description: TxInf/OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgId (#6): GrpHdr/MsgId of the recalled pacs.008.

OriginalSettlementDate.description: TxInf/OrgnlIntrBkSttlmDt (#11): not in the future, not older than the scheme's recall window.

ReasonCode.description: TxInf/CxlRsnInf/Rsn/Cd (#13): recall reason (Annex D §3.5.6 Recall Reasons, e.g. DUPL, FRAD, TECH, CUST, AC03, AM09).

Camt056RecallRequestDto.description:
JSON REST contract for camt.056.001.11 (Request for Recall of an Instant Credit Transfer), sent by the original
            debtor participant. Carries the client-supplied rows of the NBG field profile "IPS_camt.056 - V1" (37 rows; the
            numbers in the remarks are that table's row numbers). IPS enforces a single TxInf, so the DTO is flat.
            Rows fixed by Annex D (§3.2.4) are not on the contract — the gateway always fills them: #2 Assgnr (participant
BIC), #3 Assgne (IPS BIC), #7 OrgnlMsgNmId ("pacs.008.001.12"), #12 CxlRsnInf/Orgtr AnyBIC (= DbtrAgt, the
participant), #15 ClrSys "IPS", #16 SvcLvl, #17 LclInstrm, #19 CdtrRefInf/Tp/CdOrPrtry/Cd "SCOR".The same shape is delivered to the core system at string Camt056RestApiRoutes.Receive for an incoming recall of a
pacs.008 this bank received: every field is filled from the received message as IPS forwarded it, the creditor agent is
this participant, and string? Camt056RecallRequestDto.ClientReference is empty.

Camt056RemittanceInformationDto.description: OrgnlTxRef/RmtInf: Ustrd (Max140Text) and one Strd/CdtrRefInf (Annex D: a single Structured occurrence).

Id.description: The party's identification (organisation or private), when given.

Camt056UltimatePartyDto.description: UltmtDbtr / UltmtCdtr: Pty/Nm and Pty/Id only.

IpsMessageKind.description: The kind of IPS message a transaction belongs to. Serialized as its name ("Pacs008", …).

TransactionId.description: OrgnlTxId: the transaction id of the original payment.

InstructionId.description: OrgnlInstrId: the instruction id of the original payment, when given.

EndToEndId.description: OrgnlEndToEndId: the end-to-end id of the original payment.

UETR.description: OrgnlUETR: the UETR of the original payment, when given.

ValueDate.description: The settlement date of the original payment (OrgnlTxRef/IntrBkSttlmDt, or OrgnlIntrBkSttlmDt).

OriginalMessageId.description: OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgId: the message id of the original payment, when given.

OriginalMessageNameId.description: OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlMsgNmId: the original message definition, for example pacs.008.001.12, when given.

OriginalCreationDateTime.description: OrgnlGrpInf/OrgnlCreDtTm: when the original message was created, when given.

Amount.description:
OPTIONAL. The original payment's amount — TxInf/OrgnlIntrBkSttlmAmt (Annex D 2.9, [1..1]). Empty → the returned
Amount/Currency is sent (a full return, which FOCR is).

Currency.description: OPTIONAL. Currency of decimal? Pacs004OriginalPaymentReferenceDto.Amount; empty → the return's Currency.

ClientReference.description:
REQUIRED. The core system's unique id for this transaction — unique across every message type. The idempotency
key: a repeated request with the same value returns the existing transaction instead of sending again.

Id.description: TxInf/RtrId, equal to GrpHdr/MsgId: the return id. On send it is chosen by the caller and must be unused; on delivery it is also the Idempotency-Key and the payment-status reference.

Currency.description: RtrdIntrBkSttlmAmt/@Ccy: the currency of the returned amount.

ValueDate.description: IntrBkSttlmDt: the settlement date of the return.

InstructingAgent.description: BIC of the participant returning the funds (GrpHdr/InstgAgt; on delivery OrgnlTxRef/CdtrAgt when absent).

SenderClrSysMmbId.description:
OPTIONAL. The indirect participant returning the funds (TxInf/OrgnlTxRef/CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/ClrSysMmbId/MmbId,
Max35Text). Outgoing: must be in IpsStp:IndirectParticipants; empty = the return is our own. Incoming: as received.

InstructedAgent.description: BIC of the participant receiving the returned funds (GrpHdr/InstdAgt; on delivery OrgnlTxRef/DbtrAgt when absent).

ReturnReasonCode.description: RtrRsnInf/Rsn/Cd (or Prtry): the return reason. On send only FOCR is accepted.

DebtorSWIFT.description:
Bank BIC that serviced the original debtor. For the core system's own reference only — not sent:
            OrgnlTxRef/DbtrAgt is string? Pacs004PaymentReturnRequestDto.InstructedAgent. Empty on a received return.

CreditorSWIFT.description:
Bank BIC that serviced the original creditor. For the core system's own reference only — not sent:
            OrgnlTxRef/CdtrAgt is our BIC. Empty on a received return.

OriginatorName.description: Not sent (not in Annex D §8.1.4). Kept for the core system's own reference.

OriginatorAddress.description: Not sent (not in Annex D §8.1.4). Kept for the core system's own reference.

AdditionalInfo.description: Not sent: RtrRsnInf/AddtlInf is not in Annex D §8.1.4 (2.12-2.18 has Orgtr and Rsn/Cd only).

Pacs004PaymentReturnRequestDto.description:
JSON REST contract for pacs.004 (payment return) requests. Field names mirror
SWIFT.Middleware.Domain.XmlEntities.Pacs004.ReturnPaymentsEntity (the core template) where the
underlying data is identical, and reuse Pacs008AgentDto/Pacs008PartyDto shapes since those
concepts (agent, party) are the same across pacs.004/008/009.

Value.description: The code or the proprietary value.

Pacs008CodeChoiceDto.description: Code or proprietary value (Type 0 = Cd, 1 = Prtry). Used by pacs.009.

identifier.description: CONDITIONALLY REQUIRED. Cdtr/Id/OrgId|PrvtId/Othr/Id (branch chosen by int? Pacs008CreditorRequestDto.Type).

participantBic.description:
REQUIRED. CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI — the creditor's direct IPS participant (receiving bank, the direct
participant of an indirect one, or Treasury). IPS routes the payment by this value (Annex D §3.2).

indirectParticipantBic.description: OPTIONAL. CdtrAgt/FinInstnId/ClrSysMmbId/MmbId (ClrSysId/Cd = "GE"): the creditor's indirect participant (Max35Text).

account.description: REQUIRED. CdtrAcct/Id/IBAN (Treasury receivers are addressed by IBAN too).

Pacs008CreditorRequestDto.description: Payee, including the creditor's bank — the only place the receiving participant appears in pacs.008.

participantBic.description:
INBOUND ONLY (IPS → core). DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/BICFI — the payer's direct IPS participant. On a send it is
always the gateway's own BIC, so it may be omitted; a different value is rejected.

identifier.description: CONDITIONALLY REQUIRED. Dbtr/Id/OrgId|PrvtId/Othr/Id (branch chosen by int? Pacs008DebtorRequestDto.Type).

billIdentifier.description:
OPTIONAL (BILL payments). A second Dbtr/Id/…/Othr with SchmeNm/Cd = "BILL". Not the same concept as a
structured BILL remittance reference.

indirectParticipantBic.description: OPTIONAL. DbtrAgt/FinInstnId/ClrSysMmbId/MmbId (ClrSysId/Cd = "GE"): the debtor's indirect participant (Max35Text).

Pacs008DebtorRequestDto.description: Payer. On a send the debtor bank is always the gateway's own participant BIC (IpsStp:ParticipantBic).

channelCode.description: REQUIRED when the object is present. Exactly 4 uppercase letters.

instrumentCodes.description:
REQUIRED when the object is present, at least one. Each is 4 uppercase letters and produces one
RltdRmtInf/RmtId = channelCode + ":" + instrumentCode (e.g. "MOBL:PRXY").

electronicAddress.description: OPTIONAL. RltdRmtInf/RmtLctnDtls/ElctrncAdr (Max2048Text) on every generated RltdRmtInf: POS/device coordinates.

Pacs008InitiationChannelInstrumentDto.description: Annex D §3.2.1.m initiation channel and instrument, carried in CdtTrfTxInf/RltdRmtInf.

clientReference.description: REQUIRED. Idempotency key assigned by Bank/Core; reused unchanged on retries. Not mapped to XML.

endToEndId.description: REQUIRED. CdtTrfTxInf/PmtId/EndToEndId (Max35Text). "RTP-…" for RTP, "PSP-…" for pain.001 initiated payments.

creationDateTime.description: REQUIRED. GrpHdr/CreDtTm: when the customer confirmed the payment. Stable across retries.

acceptanceDateTime.description:
REQUIRED. CdtTrfTxInf/AccptncDtTm: when the debtor participant received the instruction — the IPS SLA
reference point. 0 ≤ acceptanceDateTime − creationDateTime ≤ 1 second. Its local date is GrpHdr/IntrBkSttlmDt.

amount.description: REQUIRED. GrpHdr/TtlIntrBkSttlmAmt and CdtTrfTxInf/IntrBkSttlmAmt (one transaction per message).

categoryPurposeCode.description: OPTIONAL. GrpHdr/PmtTpInf/CtgyPurp/Cd. Omitted → no CtgyPurp element (no default).

Pacs008InstantPaymentRequestDto.description:
Bank/Core → gateway instant-payment request (outbound pacs.008.001.12), per the Bank/Core contract
"pacs.008.001.12-instant-payment-request-outbound_v1". Carries business intent only: the gateway
generates every technical XML value itself — AppHdr, GrpHdr/MsgId, PmtId/TxId, IntrBkSttlmDt, the
sender BIC (DbtrAgt/InstgAgt), fixed codes (CLRG, IPS, INST, SLEV, ClrSysId "GE", SchmeNm "BILL") and the signature.
string? Pacs008InstantPaymentRequestDto.ClientReference is the idempotency key: a retry with the same value returns the existing
transaction instead of sending a second payment. It is never written to the XML.

Id.description: Id/OrgId/Othr/Id or Id/PrvtId/Othr/Id (Max256Text), chosen by int? Pacs008PartyDto.Type.

Pacs008PartyDto.description: Debtor or creditor: name, identification and IBAN account.

channelCode.description: OPTIONAL. RgltryRptg/Dtls/Cd (Max10Text): QR, PROXY, MB, IB, NFC, …

geolocation.description: OPTIONAL. RgltryRptg/Dtls/Inf (Max35Text each): payer geolocation; one Inf per item.

Id.description: Omit it, or echo the key of the delivered message exactly: pacs.009 id, pacs.004 return id, pain.001 paymentInformationId, camt.056 and camt.029 id, camt.055 msgId. Leave it empty for a pacs.008, which carries no message id. Any other value makes the answer unusable.

EndToEndId.description: Omit it, or echo the delivered endToEndId exactly (pacs.008, pacs.009). Not checked for the other kinds.

TxId.description: Omit it, or echo the delivered txId exactly (pacs.009). Leave it empty for a pacs.008, which carries no transaction id. Not checked for the other kinds.

Status.description: ACCP (accepted), RJCT (refused, with ReasonCode) or, only in the payment-status query, PDNG (still processing); see Pacs008PaymentStatuses. Read case-insensitively.

Accepted.description: True when Status is ACCP. Informational: the gateway reads Status.

ReasonCode.description: The ISO 20022 reason of an RJCT, for example AC04 or AM04. For an incoming pacs.008 it is the reason given to IPS in the pacs.002.

InternalErrorCode.description: The core system's own error number, stored with the gateway's record of the answer.

CoreReference.description: The core system's reference of the posting, stored with the gateway's record of the answer.

Description.description: Free text, stored with the gateway's record of the answer.

ProcessedAtUtc.description: When the core system decided; the gateway records it as the time of the answer.

Pacs008PaymentResultDto.description: Final synchronous result for a pacs.008 request. This result is used by the gateway to build pacs.002.

country.description: PstlAdr/Ctry: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, two uppercase letters.

addressLines.description: PstlAdr/AdrLine: up to 490 characters, split into consecutive ≤70-character AdrLine elements (max 7).

Pacs008PostalAddressDto.description: Practical v1 subset of PostalAddress27. Every field is optional.

unstructured.description: OPTIONAL. Free text of any length (Ustrd is [0..unbounded]), split into consecutive ≤140-character RmtInf/Ustrd elements.

referenceType.description: REQUIRED. Strd/CdtrRefInf/Tp/CdOrPrtry/Prtry (Max35Text): MCC, SERV, BILL, RSCUSORDER.

reference.description: REQUIRED. Strd/CdtrRefInf/Ref (Max35Text). For MCC: the 4-digit merchant category code.

additionalInformation.description: OPTIONAL. Up to 420 characters, split into ≤140-character Strd/AddtlRmtInf elements (max 3).

type.description: REQUIRED when the object is present. 0 = organisation, 1 = individual.

name.description: REQUIRED when the object is present. …/Nm.

Pacs008UltimatePartyRequestDto.description: UltmtDbtr / UltmtCdtr: name and identification only.

Account.description: DbtrAcct or CdtrAcct: the IBAN (on delivery Othr/Id when the message has no IBAN).

ClientReference.description:
REQUIRED. The core system's unique id for this transaction — unique across every message type. The idempotency
key: a repeated request with the same value returns the existing transaction instead of sending again.

Id.description: GrpHdr/MsgId: the message id. On send it is chosen by the caller and must be unused.

InstrId.description: PmtId/InstrId: the instruction id, when given.

EndToEndId.description: PmtId/EndToEndId: the end-to-end id. On delivery it is also the Idempotency-Key and the payment-status reference.

TxId.description: PmtId/TxId: the transaction id. On send it is chosen by the caller and must be unused.

UETR.description: PmtId/UETR of a received message, when given. Not in the IPS v1 profile: accepted on send and not sent.

InstructionPriority.description: PmtTpInf/InstrPrty of a received message: 1 = HIGH, 0 = NORM, when given. Not in the IPS v1 profile: on send 0 or 1 is accepted and not sent.

TTC.description: Transaction type code kept from the source contract (at most 35 characters). Not in the IPS v1 profile: not sent, and empty on delivery.

RTGSPriority.description: RTGS priority kept from the source contract (0 or 1). Not in the IPS v1 profile: not sent, and empty on delivery.

FromTime.description: Earliest settlement time kept from the source contract; must be before RejectTime. Not in the IPS v1 profile: not sent, and empty on delivery.

RejectTime.description: Latest settlement time kept from the source contract. Not in the IPS v1 profile: not sent, and empty on delivery.

Purpose.description: Flat purpose text, matching FiToFiCreditTransferTransaction.Purpose (not a Type/Value choice).

AddPurpose.description:
CdtTrfTxInf/RmtInf/Ustrd (NBG pacs.009 - V1 #27, Max140Text). Exposed on the wire because the NBG
            profile allows it — a deliberate deviation from SWIFT's FiToFiCreditTransferTransaction, which hides this field.

Pacs009PaymentRequestDto.description:
JSON REST contract for pacs.009 (FI-to-FI credit transfer) requests.
Reuses Pacs008AgentDto/Pacs008CodeChoiceDto since agent/code-choice shapes are identical.

name.description: GrpHdr/InitgPty/Nm: the name of the PISP that initiated the payment.

bic.description: GrpHdr/InitgPty/Id/OrgId/AnyBIC: the BIC of the PISP, when given.

Pain001InitiatingPartyDto.description: GrpHdr/InitgPty: Nm (1.7) and Id/OrgId/AnyBIC (1.10, "BIC or BEI").

clientReference.description: Outgoing only: the core system's unique id (idempotency key). Empty on an incoming pain.001.

messageId.description: GrpHdr/MsgId (1.1): quoted by a pain.002 refusal as OriginalMessageId.

creationDateTime.description: GrpHdr/CreDtTm (1.2): the acceptanceDateTime of the pacs.008 that pays this initiation.

paymentInformationId.description: PmtInf/PmtInfId (2.2): the pacs.008 endToEndId is "PSP-" + this; a pain.002 quotes it as OriginalPaymentInformationId.

endToEndId.description: CdtTrfTxInf/PmtId/EndToEndId (2.30): the PISP's own reference — not the pacs.008 endToEndId.

Pain001PaymentInitiationDto.description:
pain.001.001.12 (Customer Credit Transfer Initiation) as JSON — one shape for both directions, like the other
            message types:
            * incoming (now): a PISP asks this bank, the originator participant (the payer's bank), to make a payment
            (Annex D §3.2.11). The gateway posts it to the core system at string Pain001RestApiRoutes.Receive;
* outgoing (later): this bank as a PISP.
            The parties, address and remittance use the pacs.008 Bank/Core shapes on purpose: the core system answers an
            accepted initiation with a pacs.008 and can copy them over — endToEndId = "PSP-" + string? Pain001PaymentInitiationDto.PaymentInformationId,
            acceptanceDateTime = DateTimeOffset? Pain001PaymentInitiationDto.CreationDateTime (Annex D §3.2.1.6). A refusal is a pain.002 that quotes
            string? Pain001PaymentInitiationDto.MessageId and string? Pain001PaymentInitiationDto.PaymentInformationId. Fields follow Annex D §8.1.11 (p. 180–185).

TransactionDirection.description: Who started the transaction: the core system (sent to IPS) or another participant (received from IPS).

TransactionStatus.description:
Transaction status as the core system sees it. The gateway's internal recovery states (sending, uncertain,
investigating, resending) are all reported as TransactionStatus.Processing.

clientReference.description: The core system's unique id for the transaction (unique across every message type).

coreReference.description:
Incoming only: the key the core system knows the payment by — the Idempotency-Key of the receive call
(pacs.008/009: EndToEndId, pacs.004: the return's Id). Empty on outgoing transactions.

transactionId.description: The gateway's id for the transaction.

statusAtUtc.description: When the transaction entered TransactionStatus TransactionStatusDto.Status.

reasonCode.description: ISO 20022 reason code of the status (e.g. AC01, TM01); set on rejections.

ipsInternalCode.description: IPS internal error code (Annex D, Annex 2 — e.g. 1009); set when IPS supplied one.

description.description: Free text explaining the status, for example the rejection reason given by IPS, when available.

messageId.description: GrpHdr/MsgId (or the message's own id) sent to IPS.

endToEndId.description: The end-to-end id of the transaction, when it has one.

TransactionStatusDto.description:
The gateway's view of one transaction, keyed by the core system's string TransactionStatusDto.ClientReference. Returned when a
send is accepted (202, status Processing), by the status query (GET), and posted to the core system when the
status becomes final.
